contests.title: Macon–Bibb County — senior homestead exemption tiers

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from Macon-Bibb County ad valorem taxes for county purposes: (1) In the amount of $17,000.00 of the assessed value of the homestead for residents of that county who are between the ages of 65 and 74; (2) In the amount of $32,000.00 of the assessed value of the homestead for residents of that county who are between the ages of 75 and 84; and (3) In the amount of the full assessed value of the homestead for residents who are 85 years of age or older?

measures.questionText: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from Macon-Bibb County ad valorem taxes for county purposes: (1) In the amount of $17,000.00 of the assessed value of the homestead for residents of that county who are between the ages of 65 and 74; (2) In the amount of $32,000.00 of the assessed value of the homestead for residents of that county who are between the ages of 75 and 84; and (3) In the amount of the full assessed value of the homestead for residents who are 85 years of age or older?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Creates age-based homestead exemptions from Macon–Bibb County county property taxes, including bond taxes, beginning January 1, 2027 if voters approve. Residents ages 65 through 74 would receive a $17,000 exemption from assessed homestead value; residents ages 75 through 84 would receive $32,000; residents 85 or older would receive an exemption for the full assessed value. Assessed value above a partial exemption remains taxable. The exemption replaces other homestead exemptions for these county taxes and does not apply to state, school or city property taxes. The resident or an agent must apply to the county tax commissioner; the exemption then renews while the home remains the resident’s homestead, and recipients must report loss of eligibility.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed $17,000, $32,000 and full-value homestead exemptions for the three senior age groups.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject these proposed senior homestead exemptions.
